name: Zanzibari domain of Tippu Tip
alt: Arab-Swahili state of the eastern Congo
Swahili-Arab city-states of Nyangwe and Kasongo
Zanzibari Arab domain of the upper Congo

successors.name: Congo Free State
successors.text: Maniema, the eastern Congo around Kasongo and Nyangwe

ledger.x: 1884: Tippu Tip claims the eastern Congo.
1887 February 24: Tippu Tip becomes governor of the Stanley Falls District for the Congo Free State.
1892 March: Sefu bin Hamid begins attacking the Free State, ending the client relation.
1892 November: open war between Sefu bin Hamid and the Free State.
1894 January: the last Arab-Swahili forts surrender and the domain ends.

wars.name: Stanley Falls clash of 1886
wars.outcome: 'In 1886 ... fighting broke out between the Swahili and the representatives of King Leopold II of Belgium at Stanley Falls'; Tippu Tip, in Zanzibar, then reassured the Belgian consul.

wars.name: Congo Arab war
wars.outcome: Free State victory: Nyangwe fell on 4 March 1893, Kasongo on 22 April 1893, Sefu was killed on 20 October 1893 and the last forts surrendered in January 1894 (remnants executed in December 1894).

certainty.note: A trading domain of posts and caravan routes with no frontier.
